title: Expenses
subtitle: Record project costs and business expenses in one place.

capture.title: New expense
capture.subtitle: Saving creates a draft only. The expense enters project costs after you approve it. For business overhead, add allocation lines so it is not left unallocated.

detail.title: Expense
detail.draftBanner: This expense was saved as a draft and is not included in project costs yet.
detail.finalizedBanner: The expense was recorded in the project costs.
detail.correctionHistoryHint: Original, reversing, and replacement rows stay visible. Net Actual Cost uses the corrected amount.

categoryPolicy.title: Category policy
categoryPolicy.overrideHint: You can change method and period below - this expense keeps your override.

lifecycle.draftHint: Saving creates a draft only. Approve it into costs when the amount is ready.
lifecycle.overheadUnallocatedWarning: This is business overhead with no project allocation. It will not appear in any project’s Actual Cost or Allocated Overhead until you add allocation lines.
lifecycle.overheadAllocatedHint: Allocation lines determine which projects receive a share of this overhead.

promoteVendor.title: Save as vendor
promoteVendor.description: Create or link a vendor from “{name}”. The supplier name on this expense stays as entered.
promoteVendor.success: Vendor linked. Supplier text on this expense was kept.

correction.title: Correct expense
correction.subtitle: Creates a reversing entry for the original and a draft replacement with the corrected figures. History stays intact.
correction.success: Correction draft created. Approve the replacement when ready.

confirm.finalizeConsequence: The expense will be recorded in the project costs.
confirm.voidConsequence: It will be excluded from all cost figures.
confirm.reverseQuestion: Create a reversing entry for the expense of <amount></amount> from <date></date>?
confirm.reverseConsequence: The original stays in history. A linked negative expense zeros its Actual Cost impact.
confirm.correctQuestion: Create a reversal and a corrected draft for the expense of <amount></amount> from <date></date>?
confirm.correctConsequence: The original stays in history. A reversing entry offsets it, and a new draft holds the corrected amount.

fields.amountTaxModeHint: Choose whether the amount includes VAT. The rate comes from the organization’s active tax rule. Actual Cost and profitability use net.
fields.recurrenceUseDrafts: This does not generate repeating expense rows. Use Recurring drafts to schedule them.

placeholders.target: Leave empty or choose a project

empty.title: Track what the business spends
empty.description: Record materials, subcontractors, rent, and other costs. Start with an amount - details can wait.

empty.title: No expenses on this project yet
empty.description: Record materials, subcontractors, and other direct costs as they happen.

allocation.title: Allocate to projects
allocation.subtitle: Without allocation lines, general/shared overhead stays off every project’s cost.
allocation.empty: Add lines so contractors can see method, period, and which projects receive a share.
allocation.autoDriverHint: The system splits NET across eligible projects in the period and stores a historical snapshot.
allocation.unallocatedCallout: No projects selected yet - this overhead will not land on project Actual Cost.

errors.inclusiveTaxRateRequired: An applicable percentage tax rule is required when the amount includes VAT.
errors.workPackageRequiresProject: A work area requires a project.
errors.directFamilyRequiresProject: Direct project cost requires a project.
errors.overheadFamilyRequiresNoProject: Business overhead cannot be used on a project expense.
errors.allocationAmountRequired: Enter an amount for each fixed-amount line.
errors.allocationPercentRequired: Enter a percentage for each percent line.
errors.allocationSumMismatch: Allocation lines must sum exactly to the expense amount.
errors.allocationProjectRequired: Project allocation lines require a project.
errors.allocationOverheadNoProject: Overhead lines cannot reference a project.
errors.notEditable: Only draft expenses can be edited.
errors.notFinalizable: Only draft expenses can be finalized.
errors.notVoidable: Only finalized expenses can be voided.
errors.reversalNotVoidable: Reversal entries cannot be voided again.
errors.alreadyReversed: This expense already has a reversing entry.
errors.notReversible: Only finalized expenses can be reversed.
errors.reversalNotReversible: Reversal entries cannot be reversed again.
errors.adjustmentNotReversible: Adjustment entries cannot be reversed this way.
errors.notAdjustable: Only finalized expenses can receive an adjustment.
errors.currencyMustMatchProject: Expense currency must match the project currency.
errors.currencyMustMatchOrganization: Overhead expense currency must match the organization currency.
errors.projectExpenseNoAllocations: Project expenses cannot be split across allocation lines.
errors.phaseProjectMismatch: The selected phase does not belong to this project.

overheadHome.title: Overhead
overheadHome.description: Business overhead and shared expenses, plus allocation runs - using the existing expense engine.

notAllowed.title: Not allowed
notAllowed.body: You need permission to view expenses to open this page.

empty.overheadBody: Record rent, insurance, and other business costs without a project, then allocate them to active work.
empty.sharedBody: Shared costs use the same allocation engine as overhead.
empty.runsBody: Automatic allocation snapshots appear here after you allocate a shared or overhead expense.
